import xarray.structure.concat as c

TARGET_LINE = 642

    if event == 'line' and frame.f_code.co_filename == TARGET_FILE and frame.f_lineno == TARGET_LINE:

            captured.append(frame.f_locals.get('variable_index').copy())
    return tracer

ds1 = xr.Dataset(data_vars={'a': ('x', [1,2]), 'temp': ('x', [10,20])}, coords={'x':[0,1]})
ds2 = xr.Dataset(data_vars={'a': ('x', [3,4])}, coords={'x':[0,1]})
out = xr.concat([ds1, ds2], dim='sample', data_vars='all', coords='minimal')
sys.settrace(None)
print('captured:', captured)
print('out sizes', out.sizes)
